description: POSTS an update (e.g. investigating → identified → monitoring → resolved) to an existing incident on the LIVE public status page (and, with notify=true, notifies subscribers). StatusPal: POST /status_pages/{subdomain}/incidents/{incident_id}/updates.

description.description: The update message shown on the status page (required).

incident_id.description: The incident id to post an update to.

notify.description: Whether to notify/email subscribers about this update.

posted_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp for the update (optional; defaults to now).

name: statuspal_create_incident_update
title: Post incident update
